comment: A hold keeps a package on the last version that works when a newer release is
broken for this repository. Holds are raised and cleared by humans, in review:
raise maxVersion (or delete the entry) and let validation prove the new version.
recheckAfter is a reminder, not an expiry.

holds.reason: viem 2.56.0 removed the ./tempo/zones export, which @wagmi/core 3.5.0 (pulled by porto through @wagmi/connectors) still imports, so the explorer Vite build fails to resolve it.
holds.evidence: pnpm --filter verax-explorer build: "./tempo/zones" is not exported under the conditions ["module", "browser", "production", "import"] from package viem
holds.clearWhen: The explorer web3 stack no longer resolves @wagmi/core 3.5.0 (see the wagmi 3 migration in #1053). Verify by raising maxVersion and building explorer and tutorial.
